excerpt:
Interviewer: Oh, wow! That is very exciting. Well, you've mentioned several times about job recommendations and Linkedin sending you relevant information job post. So just wanted to understand how you even get those recommendations like. is there a setting for that? Or how do you go about getting those recommendations.

Stakeholder: Okay? So I believe the recommendations are based on the [saved filters for the jobs] and to get those notifications. You can like the steps is basically the same when you're looking for jobs. Just that [after setting your filters for the jobs that you're looking for]. For example, [I'll just type software engineer and set the location]. And at the bottom of the screen there's a get job alerts for this search, and if you turn it on. Then Linkedin will send you notification. With the list of the recommended job postings. You can either receive the notification through the app or through email like, based on your setting. Yeah.

Interviewer: Hmm! Interesting. As a follow up. How has your experience been with alerts? Like, do you get them? How often do you get them and are you allowed to do any changes to the alerts.

Stakeholder: Okay? So yeah, you can like, manage the frequency. So to manage the frequency, you can go to the jobs tab. And at the top of the screen. You can select preferences. and then there's a job alert button, and after that you can manage the frequency for each like save job filters. you can click on the pencil icon on the right of each filter, and you can set like, whether you want to receive the recommendation on a daily basis, or like once a week. and also set the notification type. Yeah.
goal: Set filters for the jobs being looked for
